about_the_game:
Mistworld is a fantasy role-playing game filled with a classic atmosphere and a richly layered world.

Set in an age of upheaval where nations, races, and factions collide, you will follow the intertwined stories of many characters and experience an epic tale that blends a vast world, intricate structure, and deeply woven narrative.

With its familiar isometric perspective and map design inspired by classic RPGs, Mistworld delivers the immersive feeling of playing through a living fantasy novel — shaped by diverse perspectives and meaningful choices within its expansive universe.

Through free combinations of classes, equipment, and skills, players can form their own parties and enhance the strategic depth and freedom of combat.

Now, step into the grand narrative of Mistworld, where countless destinies intertwine across a world on the brink of change.

Features

The Meeting of Classic WRPG and JRPG

Mistworld aims to merge the narrative depth of classic Western RPGs with the gameplay structure of traditional JRPGs.

Create your own character, journey across a turbulent world, and encounter a variety of companions —
sharing lighthearted banter, engaging in profound conversations,
and making critical choices that will shape the course of the story.

Combat follows the classic side-view, turn-based system familiar to JRPG fans.
Elemental affinities, diverse skill and equipment combinations, and tactical flexibility
allow each character to take on different roles — from a resilient tank to a devastating attacker.

Victory lies in mastering a wide array of skills —
weakening your enemies while empowering yourself, stacking status effects,
exploiting elemental weaknesses, and using combat items with precision and timing.

Synopsis

The Western Edge of the World

At the westernmost frontier of the known world lies Larnill,
a land divided among three great powers:
the Northern Alliance of tribes and city-states,
the Kingdom of Ersinell, and the Kingdom of Kellah.

Once the dominant force across Larnill, Ersinell has fallen into decline under King Robert’s rule.
After a crushing defeat in the northern wars,
a peasant uprising was barely suppressed before a new rebellion — this time led by nobles — arose.

Now, rebel forces have rallied behind Edman,
a high noble of Kellah and the king’s own nephew,
laying siege to the royal capital of Falldorn.
It is here, amid the flames of civil war, that your party’s story begins.

Systems

  • Side-view Turn-based Combat

  • Expansive Fields, Maps, and Environments

  • Extensive Narrative Text and Dialogue

  • Multiple Branching Choices

  • Symbol-based Encounter System

  • Skill Slot System

  • Skill Usage Limits per Battle

  • Wide Variety of Equipment Categories

  • Character Builds through Gear and Skills

  • Dice Roll System

  • Lockpicking Mini-game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Any processor w/ a clock rate of 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: CPU-integrated or on-board graphics
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in sound chipset
